_readme: Canned raw scorer answers for the `mock` condition of the confidence-scorer calibration pilot (#1074). Keys are `<condition_id>::<pr_id>::<repeat_index>`. The pr_ids are SYNTHETIC pilot fixture ids (see evals/confidence-calibration/fixtures/) — they deliberately do NOT match any corpus id, so a mock row can never masquerade as a real corpus entry. Values are realistic raw model output (fenced ```json blocks or prose+JSON), because the production parser tolerates exactly those shapes. The {"__cause__": ...} entries simulate a transport-level failure with no model text at all. #1369 note: these answers predate the merge-readiness verifier contract; concern entries carry type/severity where the current parser requires them, but the reasons/scores still reflect v1 prose-quality phrasing — regenerate against the verifier prompt before the #1370 canary reuses them.
